source.title: Efficient generation of hPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neurons in a fully defined, scalable, 3D biomaterial platform

formulation.evidence: Rheological measurements indicated that 10wt% PNIPAAm-PEG hydrogels had a stiffness of ~1 kPa at 37 °C

youngs_modulus.evidence: Rheological measurements indicated that 10wt% PNIPAAm-PEG hydrogels had a stiffness of ~1 kPa at 37 °C

description.value: gels remained structurally stable and supported differentiating cells
description.evidence: We also note that the gels remained structurally stable and continued to support the differentiating cells over the initial 25-day process (Fig. 1b).

duration_days.evidence: We also note that the gels remained structurally stable and continued to support the differentiating cells over the initial 25-day process (Fig. 1b).

culture_days.evidence: the 3D platform generated 4.9±0.58 million cells from 100,000 starting cells (Fig. 2a), representing a 50-fold expansion

other_outcomes.evidence: In contrast, the 3D platform generated 4.9±0.58 million cells from 100,000 starting cells (Fig. 2a), representing a 50-fold expansion.
other_outcomes.name: cell yield after 25 days differentiation

other_outcomes.evidence: was significantly higher at day 25 on 3D (36% of cells) than on 2D (20%)
other_outcomes.name: TH+ cells at day 25

other_outcomes.evidence: TH+ neuronal differentiation plateaued at similar, high levels on both platforms (47% on 3D and 49% on 2D for H1 hESC derived mDA neurons)
other_outcomes.name: TH+ cells at day 40

other_outcomes.evidence: by contrast 78% of neurons generated in 3D (and subsequently cultured in 2D to facilitate voltage imaging analysis) fired action potentials
other_outcomes.name: fraction of D40 neurons firing action potentials

other_outcomes.evidence: 5% of the 2D-generated cells exhibited a firing pattern of periodic spikes at 2–5Hz1, typical of mature A9 type mDA neurons at this stage, compared to 25% of the cells generated on 3D
other_outcomes.name: fraction with mDA-typical 2-5 Hz periodic spiking

other_outcomes.evidence: Of these, 22.8%, or 18900± 4800 cells were TH positive.
other_outcomes.name: TH+ fraction of surviving HNA+ cells in graft

other_outcomes.evidence: 22.2% of the surviving HNA+ cells were FOXA2 positive in the 2D controls, whereas 52.6% were FOXA2 positive in the 3D generated mDA neurons
other_outcomes.name: FOXA2+ fraction of surviving HNA+ cells in graft

survival.evidence: 82300± 20900 HNA+ cells survived, corresponding to 35.6% of implanted cells.

notes: Cells differentiated encapsulated in 3D thermoresponsive gel; harvested at day 25 and implanted into rat striatum (cells implanted without material). Stiffness measured at 37 °C. Comparison 2D Matrigel control: 0.8% HNA+ survival.
